people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served Yahweh; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
translations.bsb: So they put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD, and He could no longer bear the misery of Israel.
translations.kjv: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
translations.asv: And they put away the foreign gods from among them, and served Jehovah; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
